hypothesis.statement: On real simultaneous respiration + PPG (BIDMC subject 01), the histogram transfer entropy shows directed information flow (respiration -> pulse slightly net-dominant, the model-free complement to the Granger result), transferEntropy reproduces an independent from-scratch numpy transfer entropy, and it recovers a constructed directed coupling (x -> y net TE strongly positive).

analysis_plan.dataset: BIDMC PPG and Respiration Dataset (Pimentel et al. 2017, PhysioNet), subject bidmc01; RESP + PLETH decimated 125->25 Hz, 200 s (5001 samples each)

decision.threshold: descriptive: transferEntropy equals an independent numpy transfer entropy to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-10), and recovers a constructed directed coupling (x -> y TE >> y -> x TE), on real cardiorespiratory signals
